title: Pay-GHO
tagline: A DeFi payment application for seamlessly paying through GHO
description: The project is based on facilitating any crypto payments through GHO, GHO is stablecoin so it will be easy for the receiver to get his/her money in the form of a stablecoin. GHO can facilitate different functions, application will help new users to onboard into it for the smoother flow concepts.
how_its_made: we used GHO vaults here, Ethereum, Ether.JS. We decided to use architecture based on previous system, For frontend we used react.js here and integrations is done by different tool sets, GHO vaults and ERC4556 , it will require more, using hardhat to remix for smart contract , Techstacks will be given
